build_faiss_index_from_factory: build a Faiss index from a factory string and train it on dataset vectors
run_knn_search: run a k-nearest neighbor search on a Faiss index with configurable search parameters
run_range_search: run a range search on a Faiss index with a specified radius threshold
reconstruct_encoded_vectors: reconstruct and evaluate encode-decode roundtrip quality for a Faiss codec index
set_index_params: set search parameters like nprobe or efSearch on a Faiss index dynamically
